text.value: Drag a row onto a layer or a slot
These are what the Compose export gate refuses, checked against the whole document rather than the last edit.
m3/search-input-field requires `value`; nothing is set on this layer.
`weight` is only legal inside a Row or Column; this node's parent is a Box.
layout/scaffold.content holds 0 children; it needs exactly 1.
